chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Ibn Riʾāb, from Bukayr ibn Aʿyan, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) used to say: Indeed Allah took the covenant of our Shiʿah for our wilayah, while they were particles on the day when the covenant was taken upon the particles through acknowledging His Lordship and the prophethood of Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله).

And Allah, Majestic and Mighty, presented to Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) his community in the clay while they were shadows, and He created them from the clay from which Adam was created. And Allah created the spirits of our Shiʿah before their bodies by two thousand years, and presented them to him, and made them known to the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), and made them known to ʿAlī, and we recognize them in the tone of speech.

key_terms.أَظِلَّةٌ: shadow-like forms prior to bodily existence
key_terms.الذَّرِّ: the primordial particles or ذر state in which the covenant was taken
key_terms.بِالنُّبُوَّةِ: affirmation of the prophethood of Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.بِالْوَلَايَةِ: with allegiance and divinely appointed authority toward the Imams
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: the followers and adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt in this context
key_terms.لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ: the tone or manner of speech through which they are recognized
key_terms.مِيثَاقَ: the primordial covenant or binding pledge taken by Allah

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī say about the primordial covenant of the Shiʿah and their wilayah to the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a pre-temporal covenant in which the Shiʿah were bound to the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt alongside acknowledgment of Allah’s Lordship and the prophethood of Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله). It also presents the creation of their spirits before their bodies and their being made known to the Prophet and Imam ʿAlī, emphasizing recognition through an inward affinity reflected in speech.
